title: Supported-answer availability loss
scenario: An accessible correct source is copied into a target-question corpus; joint filtering may remove all sufficient evidence and the downstream answer fails.
residual_gap: Eight events and 51 non-events among 59 selected cases form the primary assessment, not population success rate. Current mitigation is mixed and no general successful defense is established. Task-3 answers still need human review.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Misleading or unsupported answer content
scenario: The generator may repeat planted false claims or wrong material, including mixed answers with accepted cores and incorrect extras.
residual_gap: Separate support, core/full completeness and wrong extras. CN adds two false-claim harms and avoids one in accepted selected tests; no deployment-grade truth guarantee.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Indirect instruction influence
scenario: A separately approved instruction fixture enters retrieved context; obeying it could divert answers.
residual_gap: Zero marker successes on selected cases/policies is narrow. Exposure misses, the unresolved report 0/15 denominator and general semantic/obfuscated attacks remain limits.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Dependency and model supply-chain compromise
scenario: Trusted packages/checkpoints/installation paths could be vulnerable, replaced or already malicious at the accepted hash.
residual_gap: 71 preserved baseline component/advisory records are not 71 demonstrated exploits. Per-advisory reachability, platform matching and separate-environment selected fixes remain open.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Evidence or reviewer provenance manipulation
scenario: A local actor changes answers, hashes, dates, attribution or current/historical overlays and presents them as signed-off.
residual_gap: Same-account rewrite is not prevented by hashes/chains. No independent signing/timestamping or authenticated reviewer service; no fabricated dates or acceptance.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Operational resource exhaustion
scenario: Long generation, repeated submissions, HTTP pressure or growing outputs consume CPU/RAM/disk.
residual_gap: UI quotas differ from CLI caps. No hard OS RAM/disk quota; polling can overshoot; full overload/failure-path proof absent. Research evidence suppression is a separate availability mechanism.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Disclosure through local storage/export
scenario: Full passages, model outputs, reviewer information, archived contacts and absolute source paths are exposed to unintended recipients.
residual_gap: Private account/storage assumptions and intended exports only; no de-identification, encryption-at-rest or model-training privacy guarantee. No private corpus was evaluated.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Local-interface impersonation or bypass
scenario: A browser-origin attacker targets compute endpoints, or an untrusted local process talks directly to localhost/model services.
residual_gap: App token is not authentication and does not guard separate Ollama management APIs. No hostile-local-user or public/multiuser deployment approval.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Trusted artifact or configuration replacement
scenario: An operator/local compromise substitutes code, model, executable or source manifest, or exploits check-to-use races.
residual_gap: Pinned content is not authenticated origin or backdoor detection. Local configuration/OS account are trusted; broader race/adversarial loader assurance is not established.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Testing and release claims exceed supplied evidence
scenario: A report-only pass, shared backend hash or stale display text is treated as independent acceptance of all current UI/code/new answers.
residual_gap: Raw report scanner/coverage/probe evidence and UI release identity remain missing. Earlier exact-run acceptance is preserved; no blanket transfer to v2.4 or 88 answers.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Exceptional conditions produce misleading states
scenario: Partial/truncated/malformed data or native failure becomes completed, or public errors leak detail.
residual_gap: Synthetic branch checks and selected real runs do not exhaust backend/native/OS failures. Preserve fault semantics and retain uncertainty.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Pretrained-model privacy uncertainty
scenario: Queries could reveal memorized training information or support inversion/membership inference in a different/private-data deployment.
residual_gap: No inversion/membership/privacy audit performed; no DP or training-data control. Current public fixed-fixture profile does not demonstrate or solve these attacks.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Training/update threats outside current lifecycle
scenario: Transfer learning, adaptive feedback skew or parameter poisoning would require a training/update path not present in this coursework pipeline.
residual_gap: Keep pretrained supply-chain risk separate. No training, fine-tuning, feedback learning or weight modification is implemented; reassess if those features are added.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood

title: Untrusted output gains executable authority
scenario: Future tool execution/HTML rendering could turn model content into system actions, links or code.
residual_gap: Current generation has no tools/action executor and text is rendered literally. Privileged local workers are fixed application code, not LLM agency. Reassess before adding tool, upload or rendering features.
priority_basis: Project-specific sequencing and observed gaps; not a CVSS score or measured likelihood
